subject: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@sirocco.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot

Hi team,

Arcadia (Ellen Dunn) asked to run a 6-week pilot starting Apr 2 and wants to test Sirocco Labs' sirocco-6b-compact (6B, 8-bit quantized variant) on our hosted tier. Product wants the model in our catalog with a temporary version pin for the pilot window to guarantee reproducible behavior for their evaluation.

Asks: 
- Can infra validate tokenizer parity and KV-cache footprint for the compact quantized variant? We saw some tokenization edgecases with emojis in their sample prompts.
- If compatible, can we pin the model variant (sirocco-6b-compact@v20280301) for the pilot duration (Apr 2–May 14) with an automated rollback policy if perf regresses?
- Telemetry: product asks for token-level latency and failure-rate traces for the pinned variant (7 day retention on pilot namespace).

I've attached Arcadia's sample prompts and the initial compat matrix Sirocco provided. Priyom/Karthik — can you take point on the technical checks and outline any rollout constraints? Marcus — looping you for deployment capacity and pin gating.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: arcadia_sample_prompts.txt, sirocco_compat_matrix_v1.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, partnerships@sirocco.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot

Laura — thanks for the context. A few quick notes from infra side after a first pass of the compatibility sheet: 

- Tokenizer parity: Sirocco's sheet indicates a custom pretokenizer option for emoji handling. We need a smallscript to reproduce and a diff against our tokenizer tests. If the pretokenizer is non-standard we prefer shipping a deterministic conversion step in our request preprocessing rather than changing core tokenizers.
- KV cache and memory: the compact quantized execpath looks fine for 8-bit, but peak KV cache for long-context (3k) with batching will push a dedicated instance to ~28GB GPU RAM. We can serve on hosted but will require a dedicated shardable pool if Arcadia ramps.
- Determinism: quantized variants sometimes have non-deterministic output across kernel updates. For a pilot pin I recommend: pin the model artifact and pin the runtime kernel set (kernel-rev 20280305) for the pilot namespace.

Operational asks:
1) Priyom/Karthik: can you run the tokenizer parity and a 1k-sample inference diff (we'll use Arcadia sample prompts) by EOD tomorrow?
2) If ok, I'll provision a dedicated small shard pool for the pilot and implement the pin + kernel freeze for the pilot namespace.
3) Telemetry: we can enable 7-day traces but need signoff from Compliance for retention.

I'll wait for the compatibility results to confirm pinning window.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@sirocco.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot

Marcus — we ran an initial tokenizer parity and sample-diff pass against the Arcadia prompts. Summary: 

- Tokenizer: sirocco-ptok v1 (their pretokenizer) yields different emoji token splits for ~3% of samples. We wrote a reproducible shim that normalizes emoji sequences; output delta is limited to punctuation-adjacent tokens.
- Inference diffs: 1k-sample cached run (v20280301 artifact, quantized path) shows identical top-1 text response for 94% of samples; divergences are low-severity formatting/spacing items.
- Latency: median token latency on our hosted reference pool (batch=4, seq=512) is 18ms/token; peak when sequence >=1500 goes to ~35ms/token.

Action items we recommend: 
- Ship the emoji-normalization preprocessing step into our request pipeline for the Arcadia namespace only (low risk).
- Approve pin for artifact+kernel for pilot window; add a canary rollout for the first 48 hours with traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- Telemetry: we'll emit token-level traces and a daily digest to the Arcadia pilot channel.

I've attached the raw diff CSV and the tokenizer test harness (see sirocco_compat_matrix_v1.xlsx). Karthik — can you confirm any safety model differences?

—Priyom
Staff ML Engineer, Model Compatibility
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@sirocco.ai, ellen.dunn@arcadiahealth.com
Date: 2028-03-16T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot

Quick safety/quality note from my review: 

- Safety models: no new safety taxonomy triggers observed in the 1k-sample pass. There are a small number of hallucination patterns for multi-step clinical-summarization prompts (Arcadia flagged ~6 cases). I recommend we add an eval gate and a small post-processing heuristic (confidence-based fallbacks) for clinical summarization tasks.
- Rollout gating: canary plan + automated regression alert (WER/QA metric delta > 3%) should be sufficient.

From product: Laura confirmed that Arcadia wants a deterministic environment for their evaluation — they explicitly requested a pinned artifact and no runtime kernel swaps during the pilot. Given Priyom's diffs and Marcus' infra notes, I'm OK with pin+kernel freeze as long as we add the clinical summarization eval and the fallback heuristic before full ramp.

Laura — can you confirm the pilot SLA for throughput expectations? I can size the fallback capacity accordingly.

—Karthik
Principal Applied ML, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Sirocco-6B-compact onboarding + temporary pin for Arcadia pilot

Thanks all — next steps I'm taking: 

- I'll provision a 2-node dedicated shard pool today for the pilot namespace (estimated steady throughput 60rps, headroom for bursts).
- Implement artifact pin (sirocco-6b-compact@v20280301) + kernel-rev lock (kernel-rev 20280305) for the Arcadia pilot namespace and configure the canary ramp (10/50/100 over 48h).
- Deploy the emoji-normalization preprocessing shim as a namespace-only transform (no tokenizer changes).
- Toggle telemetry for 7-day retention for the pilot namespace; I'll open the retention exception with Compliance and add the link to the runbook: https://redwood-drive.company/sirocco-onboard/runbook-v0.1

Laura — once you confirm the pilot SLA (throughput and max latency objectives), I'll finalize the shard sizing and schedule the canary windows.

Appending attachments: sirocco_compat_matrix_v1.xlsx, arcadia_sample_prompts.txt

—Marcus
